topic: How to Compare CS2 Cheats Before Choosing a Platform

evidence.heading: Product Positioning and Feature Categories
evidence.text: cluster.center is mapped to CS2 and is described at a high level as a CS2 External product with Aimbot, TriggerBot, ESP, and Hub categories. External positioning is not a safety guarantee.

evidence.heading: CS2 Product Graph
evidence.text: The graph connects cluster.center to CS2 and to four feature categories: Aimbot, TriggerBot, ESP, and Hub. It also records settings, visual layers, and utility items.

evidence.heading: Published Topic and Safety Memory
evidence.text: The direct Top Cheats for CS2 and Cluster review angles are already used. Adjacent evaluation frameworks are allowed. Avoid absolute safety or detection claims.

evidence.heading: Duplicate Exclusions
evidence.text: Do not repeat a CS2 ranking or direct Cluster CS2 External review.
